recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any broader review of other author/source elements should remain with their own Jira issues and responsible work groups rather than expanding this List-specific reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-22667 asked to add RelatedPerson as a possible reference for List.source so a non-professional carer can author or define a list. The Jira issue is Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification for R5.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-22667 was found. The same List.source change family applied the requirement through commit 696dd29d5fe494b7433e6cad508834948fd2b648, which added Organization and RelatedPerson to List.source. FHIR-25254 later added CareTeam after RelatedPerson was already present.
additional_context: The List resource is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/list/structuredefinition-List.xml includes RelatedPerson among List.source Reference targetProfiles, and the List-source SearchParameter has no conflicting target restriction. Related issues FHIR-25254, FHIR-30154, and FHIR-27551 are already represented on the combined branch. Zulip caregiver discussion supports allowing RelatedPerson for List.source; Confluence searches found no conflicting FHIR-22667 guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch because the current FHIR core source already implements the seed issue.
